head: Ellipsus, a writing app for co-authors, enters the App Store charts
dek: Ellipsus is a creative writing app for writing alone or with others: unlimited documents, drafts and collaborators, comments, chat and version history. It came out on 2 November and was #18 in Productivity among free apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: Drafts can be merged like versions of code. It's made by Ellipsus GmbH and is free with in-app purchases.
means: If you write stories with a co-author, beta readers or an editor, you can work on the same text on your phone.
todo: Download Ellipsus from the App Store; check what the in-app purchases unlock.
